title: Retrospective study on the influence of technological advancements in mammography systems on radiation exposure in diagnostic and interventional mammography
summary: In mammography, the breast is examined using X-rays. The equipment used for this has been technically refined in recent years. This study investigates whether and how radiation exposure for patients has changed with a newer mammography system compared with an older one. For this purpose, existing data from examinations performed as part of routine care at our hospital are analysed. No additional examinations are carried out for the study, and the data are analysed in anonymised form.
conditions: Radiation exposure in diagnostic and interventional mammography

interventions.name: Patients aged 18 years or older who underwent diagnostic or interventional mammography in routine clinical care on the technologically advanced mammography system and suitable prior examinations on the older mammography system. criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Diagnostic or interventional mammography performed in routine clinical care at the study centre between 07/2016 and 07/2026 on an older or a technologically advanced mammography system.
Exclusion criteria:
Incomplete dose data, incomplete technical metadata, missing or non-evaluable image data, incorrect or non-comparable examination protocol, side or projection not assignable, and examinations with relevant technical artefacts that prevent reliable evaluation.
